programme.title: Saindo Da Depressão - Ep. 183
programme.desc: A depressão, para além de ser a doença do século, afeta milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Sintomas como tristeza constante, desânimo, falta de vontade para viver são sentimentos de quem sofre com depressão. Sendo este um problema sério com urgente resolução, o programa Saindo da Depressão tem sido a alavanca de mudança para inúmeras pessoas que superaram esta patologia, que infelizmente ainda mata.

programme.title: Milagres De Jesus - Ep. 131
programme.desc: Na Bíblia vêm descritos os mais extraordinários milagres. Situações que careciam de uma mudança e que são bastante comparáveis aos problemas de hoje em dia. Para todos os problemas, a fé tem um desfecho essencial, por isso veja neste programa, como os Milagres Acontecem. Os milagres existem e este programa é a prova disso mesmo.

programme.title: Nosso Tempo - Ep. 157
programme.desc: O programa mostra que não há limites para a fé. Todos os dias, casos verídicos de pessoas que superaram os seus problemas e hoje têm uma vida transformada.

programme.title: Reflexão Bispo Macedo - Ep. 131
programme.desc: Uma palavra de coragem, o conhecimento da fé inteligente, o reavivamento, a motivação para transformar um erro numa segunda oportunidade. Em Reflexões com Bispo Edir Macedo poderá reter uma mensagem única em cada episódio, que lhe irá deixar em reflexão e consequentemente mudança sobre as lacunas que enfrenta todos os dias.

programme.title: Oração Da Família Ao Pé Da Cruz - Ep. 183
programme.desc: A Cruz significa a vitória que o Senhor Jesus nos proporcionou contra todos os males na vida dos que creem. Por isso, de diariamente às 18 horas,junte-se a nós, para orarmos por toda a sua família. Neste momento, acompanhe também relatos de pessoas que foram transformadas de dentro para fora e que assim alcançaram a verdadeira felicidade, através das orações ao pé da Cruz.

programme.title: Heartland T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A série 'Heartland' acompanha a vida da família Fleming-Bartlett na gestão de um rancho de cavalos no Canadá, focando na jovem Amy, que, após a morte da mãe, assume o dom de curar e reabilitar cavalos. programme.title: Nos Passos De Jesus - Ep. 131
programme.desc: Nos Passos de Jesus é um programa especial que vai auxiliar no entendimento da palavra de Deus, através de diversos textos bíblicos que revelam o conforto, o refrigério, a paz, a felicidade e tudo o que as sagradas escrituras contêm, para assim, se obter um sólido conhecimento espiritual. Neste programa, casos verídicos de transformação são também conhecidos e revelados como é ilimitado o poder de Deus.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A forensic look at how polar bears hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics they use to track, stalk and ambush seals, whales and walruses. We follow a mother fighting to feed her two cubs in the harsh polar extremes, and a young male driven by starvation to tackle enormous prey.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A forensic look at how wolf packs hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the way they work together to locate, isolate and bring down large bison and musk oxen. An arctic wolf pack must make a kill before the harsh winter arrives, while further south, grey wolves take on prey 10 times their size.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A forensic look at how leopards hunt prey both large and small, offering a new perspective on the way these silent killers stalk and ambush everything from impala to wildebeest and catfish to storks. A female leopard deploys stealth, strength and agility to take down prey on land, in water and from the air.

programme.desc: She leads the formidable Sausage Tree Pride, an ensemble of buffalo-slaying huntresses. That is, until the migration crosses their prime domain and they demonstrate ultimate adaptability and switch prey species. But the pride has been compromised after a split-away group left their ranks and now she must muster her troupe to excel at motherhood while male coalitions complicate dynamics all around them.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Identified by her burnt orange gaze, she leads a pride of five closely-related lionesses and their six offspring. They overcome every challenge as a precision unit: the gauntlet of the buffalo hunt or the upheaval of new males that could either decimate the prides ranks or offer her the chance to finally mother cubs. But desperate drought and crippling disease push the sisterhood to the absolute brink of survival.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: She overthrew the preceding ruler of North Clan in an unprecedented take-over, fighting her way up from a lowly rank to matriarch. She is both a ruthless battle commander, leading her clan in warfare against rivals and adversaries like lion, and devoted guardian to her clan and parent to her offspring. .

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: To see them stride across the Mara is a spectacle indeed. An undeniable band-of-brothers, these males significantly enhance their odds of survival against the larger super-predators of the savanna, lions and hyenas, and prove an attractive dynamic to the female spotted athletes also forging a living on the plains. But no partnership comes without its challenges and leadership amongst the group is not a done deal either.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T24 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A Chihuahua in emergency labor has Dr. Nicole on high alert as she attempts to save the mother and puppies. The clinic reels in a curious case of a cat and a fishhook, while a preemie goat and a spooked trail horse both need care for their ailing eyes. Dr. Pol weighs in on an age-old debate: crunchy or smooth?.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T24 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Dr. Pol has helped kids show animals at the county fair for more than 40 years. For some families, its a tradition going back generations. Raising fair animals takes months of work, and it all pays off at showtime! At the clinic, Doc helps a limping steer with a swollen leg, Dr. Brenda treats a urinary blockage that threatens a cats kidneys, and Dr. Lisa bandages a wounded dog.

programme.title: Killer Snakes - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Packed with a potent neurotoxic venom, one family of snakes kill more people than any other on earth. These are the elapids – a family that includes the the black mamba, the king cobra, the inland taipan, and the krait. Their venom is one of the most toxic substances on earth; but in a strange twist of fate, it can also save lives.

programme.title: Snake City: Snakes In The City Beyond The Venom Compilation T7 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The city of Durban is home to over 25 species of snakes. Simon, Sioux and Mbali face off with a whole bunch of them. An elusive boomslang is hiding from the team in the roof of a house. As the rain begins to pour, the trio must find a hungry black mamba hiding inside an orphanage. Then, Simon and Mbali are sprayed in the face with venom from a spitting cobra.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land Of Leopards - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Botswana’s Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She’ll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms.

programme.title: Killer Safari: Big Cat Battle Compilation T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard’s hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Winter Of The Bear - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she’ll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food.
